testEffect: The test asserts that `checkout` calls the global `Math.round` exactly once — an internal implementation choice inside `applyDiscount` — instead of asserting on `checkout`'s return value.
productionEffect: Reimplementing `applyDiscount`'s rounding without calling `Math.round` directly (for example rounding via `Number(value.toFixed(2))`), while returning the identical externally observed value, would break this test even though checkout's behavior is unchanged; it is expected to fail under that semantics-preserving refactor.
